Hi there. My name is Paula and I am from Lisbon, but I live in Dublin now. I am thirty-nine, and I work in a hospital. I do not work on the weekend, so that is when I practice my English. I have two children, a boy and a girl, and a very old cat. In my free time I read, I go out with friends, and I walk in the park near my house. I do not travel much, because tickets are expensive, but I want to see more of the world. That is me, in one minute. Now tell me about you. Where do you live, what do you do, and what do you like doing when you are not working?

Here is the smallest thing you can do in English, and it changes everything. When somebody asks you a question, answer it, and then give the question back. Three words: what about you? That is it. Most people who feel stuck in English are not stuck because of grammar. They answer the question, they stop, and then there is a silence, and the silence feels like their fault. It is not. A conversation has two people in it, and the person who only answers is doing half the work. So practice the return. Where do you live? I live in Sao Paulo. What about you? What do you do? I work with technology. And you? You do not need long sentences. You need short answers and one question back, every time. Do that, and the other person keeps talking, and you get thirty free seconds to think.

Sunday is the only day that is completely mine, so I protect it. I get up late, which for me means eight o'clock, and the first thing I do is take the dog out. We walk for about an hour, always in the same park, and I meet the same four or five people there every week. I know their dogs better than I know their names. Then I come home and I cook something slow, because during the week I never have time for that. In the afternoon I do not make plans. Sometimes I go to the movies on my own, sometimes a friend calls and we go out, and sometimes I do absolutely nothing and I do not feel bad about it. What I do not do on a Sunday is open my work computer. That rule is mine, and it is the reason Monday is possible.
